measurement_note: Size is the Matches row count n. Rows are supplied in reverse chronological order and alternate seven-win runs with draw or loss interruptions, forcing per-player date ordering and segment aggregation. The reviewed query takes O(n log n) time for its window order. A correct correlated-prefix query rescans earlier matches for each row, completes every tier, and fails only by quadratic scaling.
